pr_title: posix: device_io: implement fdopen(), fileno(), pread(), pselect(), pwrite()
pr_body:
Implement the remaining functions in the `POSIX_DEVICE_IO` Option Group.

This Option Group is requried for the PSE51, PSE52, PSE53, and PSE54 subprofiles and likely others.

[Doc Preview](https://builds.zephyrproject.io/zephyr/pr/73978/docs/services/portability/posix/index.html)

Fixes #24966
Fixes #66932 
Fixes #66938 
Fixes #66946 
Fixes #66947 
Fixes #66948
pr_comments:
This one has a false positive regarding the reserved word "remove" due to the `remove()` function existing in a file that was touched.

No changes made there, although it is an ISO C function, and not a POSIX one. That would be a good bugfix at some point.
Fixes for a few bugs prepended.

Bulk changing the milestone from everything which did not make it to the v3.7.0 freeze deadline
and which is not labeled as a bug or documentation (or does not appear clearly as only containing
a bug fix or a documentation change).
If you disagree about this change please add the milestone again.

Please note that until rc2 only PRs containing bug fixes, docs and tests can be merged.
After that and until release only bug fixes and docs changes.

Exceptions require approval by the release team and a vote by the TSC.
https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/project/release_process.html#stabilization-phase
temporary DNM until merge conflicts and all comments have been addressed.

* rebased
* fixed merge conflicts
* updated language for non-user-selectable Kconfig options (i.e. do not use "Select 'y'" if the user cannot select y)
Other than the false positive in coding guidelines, this should probably be all green. Please revisit when you have a moment @ycsin, @jukkar, @SeppoTakalo

issue_context.title: posix: device_io: implement `pread()`
issue_context.body:
This is part of the See [POSIX Roadmap for LTSv3](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/51211) (RFC #51211).

`pread()` is required as part of `POSIX_DEVICE_IO` [Subprofiling Option Group](https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/xrat/V4_subprofiles.html).

For more information, please refer to https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/functions/pread.html
